content: Paulus Ye Foloy Woal Ephesus
Yodwe ye chil mel Apollos woal Corinth, ngo Paulus yesa dar chog woal fuluy yee, la budoh woal Ephesus. Yela budoh sala chungur sibis Kristiano,
iwe ngo sa kasiyar bo, “Ye bidiy Espritu Santus uwomi irel yodwe ha Kristiano iyang?” Ngo ir resa sor bo, “Hated rongrong mwo le yor mala Espritu Santus.”
Paulus yesa kasiyar bo, “Ila ngo ifa sengal yami baptismus?” Ngo ir resa sor bo, “Ha baptismus le tappel baptismus we Johannes ye foloyu.”

Iwe ngo Paulus yesa kangalur bo, “Baptismus we yael Johannes ila yar rechoka resa tagul tang molfidir; iwe ngo Johannes ye kangalur yarmetal Israel bo rebe chepar irel yeramtala yebe hamirdoh mo wol miril, le ila mala Jesus.”
Molwe re rongrong chog mele ngo resa baptismus irel mala idel Samol Jesus.
Paulus yesa yetedah paol uwor, iwe ngo yesa bidiy Espritu Santus uwor; ngo resa yalol sew mo sew fuluy le re kapta mokwe yalol Deus.
Leper mal ka ila rebe seg mo rumal.
Suluw meram le Paulus yema loh irel imwel ttey we yar. Iwe ngo yema hapatpat ngalir yarmat ngo ye kkel yal foloy le ye yeyedamgilir chog bo rebe chepar irel mala Lamliyel Deus.

Ngo ye mel sibis ir le ye kkef repiyer, le rete chepar. Iwe ngo imor panger chowe re tteydoh ngo resa hapatpat tayikofloh irel mekla Kofal Samol. Iwe Paulus sa fesangur chotugul kowe resa hawagilir rechokwe rete chepar. Iwe ngo sama pangal ral ngo ye ma foloy mo lal imw we Tyrannus yema haskun iyang.
Lal loh ruwow raeg le iye sengal chog mele Paulus yema foru. Ila panger rechokwe re mel woal mokwe faluyel Asia, le Jews fengal mo Gentiles ngo re rongrong molwe yalol Samol.
Mal Kowe Lol Sceva
Deus yesa fang kamalal Paulus bo yebe faor kkemal kowe ye kkel.
Handkerchiefs mo mengagol yengang kala yema teptap iyang ngo rebe hasiloh irer chotomay, ngo yema chuyloh yar tomay ngo ye chuy moniyan mo uwor.

Sibis Jews le rema malekah fedal ngo re kkachuchuy moniyan mo uwor yarmat, ila re hagla yar tapeli mala idel Samol Jesus bo rebe foru mele. Re kangalur moniyan kowe bo, “Irel mala idel Jesus we Paulus yema foloyu kaptal, ngo chuy mo uwol yeramtala.”
Fismol tarmal lol Sceva we Llulupal Temarong we yar Jews mele re foforu mele.
Iwe ngo moniyan we yesa kangalur bo, “Igula Jesus ngo irongrong kaptael Paulus; iwe ngo hami, hami itey?”
Iwe ngo mal we ye mel moniyan we uwol yesa tagul ngalir sa llir le ye kkel yal fedeg. Iwe ngo resa ddar mo irel imw le imwal le resa rol waes ngo ye mesrere fedal mokwe mengagur.
Panger Jews mo Gentiles kowe re mel woal Ephesus ngo re rongrong kaptal mele; pangerloh ngo yesa kkel yar motog. Iwe ngo yesa kkel loh tot yal ssor molwe idel Samol Jesus.
Ye cholop chotugul kowe le re budoh resa kaptaloh luwul yarmat mekla ir resa foru.
Ye cholop rechokwe rema folus le re hateyilidoh babior kala yar resa fisgi mo imol yarmat. Rela hapcha paliyel pangal loh babior kowe ngo ye hola lemeg sangeras dolla.
Ye ttir yal kkel loh mo yal daoloh molwe yalol Samol irel kkalel molwe resa foru.
Lofidfid We Woal Ephesus

Yela wol miril pangal meka ngo Paulus yesa hatugulu le bele loh woal pangal loh Macedonia mo Achaia, ngo yesa loh woal Jerusalem. Paulus yesa sor bo, “Bela wol miril yai loh woal Jerusalem, ngo isa loh bo ibela tefael mo wol Roma.”
Iwe ngo yesa hafengaloh Timothy mo Erastus, le rumal mokwe re tipingiyal, bo rebe loh wol Macedonia, ngo iy yesa mel tot wol mokwe faluyel Asia.
Irel yodle ngo yor mele ye weldoh woal Ephesus le fael foloy kowe kaptal Samol.

Semal chol sussul parang kowe silver, le Demetrius mala idal le yema ffaor liyosol templum we yael deus fefel we Artemis. Iwe ngo yengang le yal ila ye cholop salpiy le yema yoh ngalir chol yengang kala lol.
Iwe yesa hateyili fengalir chol yengang kowe yal mo wol sibis le ye kekafedeg yar yengang, ngo yesa kangalur bo, “Re mal, ha gola le ye palleng yach mmal mo irel yengang le.

Iwe ngo igla ngo hasa spegil wiri ngo ha rongrong meka yeramtale Paulus sa foforu. Yesa sor bo deus ka foruyel paol yarmat ila te deus, ngo yesa cholop le resa weg ngali mo woal Ephesus le mo wol meka faluyel Asia.

Ye hammerah mele bo yebe yoh le be hatayikofaloh kaptal yengang le yach. Iwe ngo te wol ila chog, bo templum le yael Artemis ngo bele tor loh kofal. Iwe ngo tewa yor loh ssarol deus le Artemis le pangal yarmat woal Asia mo faileng le ngo re kekasrowu!”
Yodwe buwa we rela rongrong mokwe ye sosor ngo resa ssong ngo resa ttawulagili, “Artemis le woal Ephesus ila iy mele ye tagiyet!”
Ngo yesa pallengloh yalol tawul we yar wol haplom we, ngo resa ddorfi Gaius mo Aristarchus, le rumal yarmetael Macedonia we re dabedoh Paulus, iwe resa hasirloh irel liliyel ttey we.
Paulus ye wol dipli le yebe loh mo imol buwa we ngo chotugul kowe re temchal fang iy.
Sibis yarmetael amm kowe maryarel, re fangloh hapatpat irel le re kekafael pechey bo towe llah loh loboswe.
Irel yodla ngo sa taroprop ttey we: sibis ngo semat mele re tetawulagili bo dolper ila re togla fal yar rol ttey fengal.
Sibis ir re kachog bo Alexander mele ye salepa meka bo ir Jews kowe resa yitliwey mo imor panger yarmat. Iwe Alexander yesa pongpong ngalir yarmat bo rebe ppoloh, ngo yesa kapatpat ngalir.
Ngo molwe yela gil ngalir le iy semal Jews, ila molwe sa pangerloh ngo re tawulagili chog sew hapatpat irel ruwow awa le rema sor bo: “Artemis le woal Ephesus ila iy mele ye tagiyet!”

Iwe ngo hoolaas we woal haplom we yesa moch hapasso buwa we le ye kangalur bo: “Yarmetal Ephesus! Pangal yarmat ngo re gola le yarmetael haplom le Ephesus mele re kekamahoy templum we yael Artemis mo porow we ye ppungdiy mo woal laeng.
Tor semal le be yoh le yebe sor bo kachapar mele. Ila hami habe hapasohmidiy ngo ha towe foru sew formel le yebe tafel.
Hasa hasirdoh mal ka iga le rete peraf lal templum ka, ngo tedyor mele ye tayikof le re sor irel deus le yach.

Hare Demetrius mo chol yengang kala lol yor yar ssong ngal semal, ila ngo yor tamol kala yar yengang mekla, ngo ye musloh rall yach tatelal hapatpat; hare yor yami ssong ngo be yoh le habe hasiloh lobosla rema tetal hapatpat mo iyang.
Iwe ngo hare chil yor tot le ha luluwaley, ila ngo hasa hasiloh irel ttey we yael fuluy.
Bo wol miril mele sa weldoh igla ngo malbo re bele sor le siya taroprop. Ngo tor mele sibe sor bo fael ttawul kowe sa iwe sengal.”
Yela wol miril yal sor mele ngo yesa hamdera ttey we.
